units.title: SG-5.5.2 Update BootScene tests for sceneSpec mock and constructor arity
Act: Confirm BootScene reads content only via the named content import
Act: Confirm BootScene.create passes sceneSpec to buildScene
Act: Confirm BootScene constructor takes zero arguments
Verify: bootSceneEffects mocks sceneSpec and passes

tests.name: builds the scene effects from the bundled bedroom scene when create() runs
tests.title: BootScene builds the scene effects from the bedroom scene when create() runs
tests.scenario: Given the mocked content and a game state, When BootScene.create() runs, Then buildEffects is called once with the scene and an effect context

tests.name: plays the authored transition when create() runs
tests.title: BootScene plays the authored transition when create() runs
tests.scenario: Given the mocked content and a game state, When BootScene.create() runs, Then playSceneTransition is called once with the transition context and the scene

tests.name: destroys every effect handle returned by buildEffects when the SHUTDOWN callback runs
tests.title: BootScene destroys every effect handle when the SHUTDOWN callback runs
tests.scenario: Given buildEffects returns two handles, When the SHUTDOWN callback runs, Then each handle's destroy is called once

tests.name: playTransition(400) starts the main camera fade-in for 400 ms
tests.title: playTransition starts the main camera fade-in for 400 ms
tests.scenario: Given a fake Phaser scene, When playTransition(400) is called, Then cameras.main.fadeIn is called with 400

tests.name: createEffect for ambientLight adds a full-scene rectangle with the authored depth
tests.title: createEffect for ambientLight adds a full-scene rectangle at the authored depth
tests.scenario: Given a fake Phaser scene and an ambientLight effect with depth 7, When createEffect runs, Then a full-scene rectangle is added with the authored colour and alpha and its depth is set to 7

units.title: Verify: bootSceneBuild asserts buildScene gets the mocked sceneSpec

tests.name: builds scene objects once from the bundled scene spec when create() runs
tests.title: BootScene builds scene objects once from the bundled scene spec when create() runs
tests.scenario: Given the content module is mocked with a fixture sceneSpec, when BootScene.create() runs, then buildScene is called once with the render context and that exact sceneSpec

tests.name: destroys every built scene object once when the scene shuts down
tests.title: BootScene destroys every built scene object once when the scene shuts down
tests.scenario: Given BootScene has created its objects, when the shutdown handler runs, then each built object is destroyed exactly once

tests.name: contains no quoted object or asset id from the bundled scene spec
tests.title: BootScene and renderContext source contain no quoted object or asset id from the scene spec
tests.scenario: Given the mocked sceneSpec ids and assets, when the BootScene.ts and renderContext.ts sources are scanned, then none of the ids appear in quotes

units.title: Verify: bootScene suite mocks content and passes with typed constructor

tests.id: bootScene.test.ts::readState returns the state currently held by the shared store
tests.name: readState returns the state currently held by the shared store
tests.title: readState returns the state currently held by the shared store
tests.scenario: Given the store holds a state, when a BootScene is created and readState is called, then the same state reference is returned

tests.id: bootScene.test.ts::calls onStateChange and returns the new reference when the store state changes after create()
tests.name: calls onStateChange and returns the new reference when the store state changes after create()
tests.title: calls onStateChange and returns the new reference when the store state changes after create()
tests.scenario: Given create() has run, when the store state changes, then onStateChange is called and readState returns the new state

tests.id: bootScene.test.ts::stops reacting to store changes after the SHUTDOWN callback runs
tests.name: stops reacting to store changes after the SHUTDOWN callback runs
tests.title: stops reacting to store changes after the SHUTDOWN callback runs
tests.scenario: Given create() has registered a SHUTDOWN callback, when that callback runs and the store changes, then onStateChange is not called

tests.id: bootScene.test.ts::emits sceneReady on the phaserToReact bus during create()
tests.name: emits sceneReady on the phaserToReact bus during create()
tests.title: emits sceneReady on the phaserToReact bus during create()
tests.scenario: Given the store holds a state, when create() runs, then sceneReady is emitted with sceneId 'boot'

REQ · bootScene suite mocks content and uses the zero-argument constructor
